name: Infisical sign-in
description: The Infisical CLI signed in on this computer, or a machine identity token in the environment.

spec.summary: A signed-in Infisical CLI on this computer. The token stays in the CLI; scripts ask it for one when they run.

instructions.*:
In a terminal, run:

```sh
infisical login
```

Pick **your instance** when it asks: US cloud (`app.infisical.com`), EU cloud (`eu.infisical.com`) or your self-hosted URL. The next step asks for the same instance; a token from one instance does not work on another.

On a server or in CI, export `INFISICAL_TOKEN` from a machine identity instead.

Then press **Check**.
